install.pnfe.description: Sent when `conda install` fails because a requested package is not in the configured channels. It is not sent when telemetry is disabled, when the plugin has no record of the request, or when a package name cannot be read (for example, a URL spec).

create.pnfe.description: Sent when `conda create` fails because a requested package is not in the configured channels. It is not sent when telemetry is disabled, when the plugin has no record of the request, or when a package name cannot be read (for example, a URL spec).

install.success.description: Sent when `conda install` succeeds. It is not sent when telemetry is disabled, for dry runs, for download-only runs, or when the plugin has no record of the request or the result.

create.success.description: Sent when `conda create` succeeds. It is not sent when telemetry is disabled, for dry runs, for download-only runs, or when the plugin has no record of the request or the result.

aau.anaconda_auth.token.description: Identifier of the Anaconda account, taken from the sign-in of anaconda-auth. It is not the API key.
aau.anaconda_auth.token.condition: The user is signed in through anaconda-auth.

aau.client.token.description: Token that identifies this client installation. It persists between runs.
aau.client.token.condition: The `anaconda-anon-usage` package is installed and can read or create its client token file.

aau.environment.token.description: Token that identifies the conda environment. It persists between runs.
aau.environment.token.condition: The `anaconda-anon-usage` package is installed and can read or create the token file of the environment.

aau.installer.tokens.description: Tokens that identify the installer used to install conda. They persist between runs.
aau.installer.tokens.condition: The `anaconda-anon-usage` package is installed and a valid installer token is configured, in a token file or in an environment variable.

aau.machine.tokens.description: Tokens that identify the machine. They persist between runs.
aau.machine.tokens.condition: The `anaconda-anon-usage` package is installed and a valid machine token is configured, in a token file or in an environment variable.

aau.organization.tokens.description: Tokens that identify the organization. They persist between runs.
aau.organization.tokens.condition: The `anaconda-anon-usage` package is installed and a valid organization token is configured, in a token file or in an environment variable.

aau.session.token.description: Token for the current run. It changes with each run.

client.sdk.version.description: Version of the Anaconda OpenTelemetry SDK that sends the signal.

conda.ci_detected.description: Whether the `CI` environment variable is set to a true value (`true` or `false`).

conda.version.description: Version of conda that sends the signal.

environment.description: Label of the deployment. It comes from the `ATEL_ENVIRONMENT` setting and is `production` by default.

installer.name.description: Name of the installer that installed conda.
installer.name.condition: The installer metadata file (.installer.info) in the base environment exists and is valid.

installer.platform.description: Platform of the installer that installed conda.
installer.platform.condition: The installer metadata file (.installer.info) in the base environment exists and is valid.

installer.version.description: Version of the installer that installed conda.
installer.version.condition: The installer metadata file (.installer.info) in the base environment exists and is valid.

parameters.description: Extra attributes that the SDK groups into one attribute.

platform.description: Name of the product platform that sends the signal (conda).

python.version.description: Version of Python that runs conda.

schema.version.description: Version of the SDK telemetry schema. It is not the same as `event.schema_version`.

service.instance.id.description: ID of this instance of the sending service. The OpenTelemetry SDK sets it.

telemetry.sdk.language.description: Programming language of the OpenTelemetry SDK.

event.schema_version.description: Version of this signal format. It is not the same as `schema.version`.

exception.missing_specs.description: Names of the packages that were not found. Only package names are sent, with no versions or URLs.

exception.name.description: Name of the error that conda raised.

install.channel_priority.description: The channel priority setting of conda.

install.channels.description: Channels used for the request. Only `defaults`, `main`, `main-x` and `conda-forge` are sent by name. Any other channel is sent as `other`.

requested.packages.description: Names of the packages that the user requested. Only package names are sent, with no versions or URLs.

resolved.packages.description: Packages that the solver chose to install.

truncated.description: Whether the plugin shortened a list to keep the signal small.
